description: Images to PDF. Turn photos and scans into one PDF, in the order you picked. HEIC from an iPhone works too. Accepts image/*, .heic, .heif, .avif; up to 50 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

pageSize.description: Page size. «By image» makes each page match its picture — best for screenshots and scans

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

quality.description: Quality for images that have to be re-encoded. JPEG and PNG go in untouched

name: pdf_from-image
